title: Surreal Rose Portrait
description: A dimly lit artistic studio scene features a wooden chair and a small table covered with a floral cloth. On the table sits a bowl of blue berries and a vibrant red rose in front of an open picture frame, all set before a large surreal painting of a face with multiple eyes and cosmic patterns.
prompt: A dimly lit artistic studio with a wooden chair and a table draped in a floral patterned cloth. On the table rests a bowl filled with blue berries and a single vibrant red rose standing before an empty open picture frame. Behind them is a massive surreal painting of a fragmented face with multiple eyes, cosmic patterns, and swirling purple and blue nebula textures, atmospheric and mysterious lighting.
